name: Yuukyuu Gensoukyoku
source: Enfield, a country revived 50 years after a tragic war. Our protagonist works in a general shop owned by a widow called Arisa, who helped him when he was lost. After Arisa has to pay a great fee to free the hero from prison for a crime he didn't commit, our hero will have two problems to solve: how will he pay back Arisa? And who's the real criminal? Maybe he'll find the answers by becoming part of the town...
translation: Enfield是一个在悲惨战争结束50年后复兴的国家。主角在名叫Arisa的寡妇经营的杂货店工作，她曾在主角迷路时帮助过他。Arisa不得不支付巨额费用，将因莫须有的罪名入狱的主角救出。如今，主角有两个问题需要解决：该如何报答Arisa？真正的罪犯又是谁？也许，他能在融入这座城镇的过程中找到答案……
